dashboard.title: Security Command Center

metric_cards.label: Security Health Score
metric_cards.visual: Radial / gauge score with color status

metric_cards.label: Total Findings
metric_cards.sub_breakdown: Critical, High, Medium, Low, Info pills

charts: Findings by Category Pie/Donut Chart (SAST vs Dependency vs Config vs Secrets)
Historical Scan Score Trend Line Chart (render only when history >= 1 scan)
sections: Recent Scans Table (Quick actions: view report, re-scan)
Recent Security Activity Stream (Timestamped audit log)
Critical Findings Preview Sheet / Drawer integration

scan_project.title: Execute Security Scan
scan_project.description: Configure path, profile, and trigger fast asynchronous scanning engine
form_controls: Folder / Repository Path Input with Browse Dialog trigger
Optional Custom Rules JSON Path Input
Profile Picker Grid: Quick (10s), Standard (30s), Deep (2m), Release Gate (Strict), Forensic (Full AST)
OSV Live API Lookup Switch (Toggle real-time vulnerability intelligence)
Start Scan Primary CTA with pulse animation during scan
live_scan_monitor: Real-time Progress Bar & Stage Stepper: [Initialization -> File Parsing -> Rule AST Match -> Dependency Audit -> OSV Query -> Report Build]
Real-time Counters: Elapsed Time, Files Processed, Findings Detected, Rules Evaluated
Live File Processing Terminal-style log drawer (Clean matte surface, no bright neon)
Scan Complete Results Summary Card with instant Navigation to Findings / Reports

findings.title: Security & Vulnerability Findings
findings.description: Triage, filter, inspect and resolve codebase vulnerabilities

inspector_panel.details: Rule metadata, CVE link, CWE ID, Remediation guidance, Code snippet viewer with masked secret evidence preview

dependencies.title: Software Bill of Materials (SBOM) & Dependencies
dependencies.description: Third-party package vulnerability inventory and license risk
components: Package Inventory Table (Package Name, Current Version, Ecosystem [npm/pypi/cargo/go], Vulnerability Count, License, Risk Level)
Package Detail Drawer (Direct vs Transitive dependencies, OSV Advisory Links, Fix Version suggestion)

osv_intelligence.title: OSV Intelligence Lookup
osv_intelligence.description: Live query against Open Source Vulnerabilities database API
osv_intelligence.lookup_form: Package Name input + Version input + Ecosystem dropdown (PyPI, npm, Crates, Go, Maven, NuGet, Packagist)
osv_intelligence.results_display: Advisory summary card, affected version ranges, CVSS score matrix, official remediation notes, raw JSON view option

reports.title: Reports & Compliance Exports
reports.description: Generate standard security compliance audit artifacts
features: Export Configuration Form (Destination folder, Include Code Snippets toggle, Min Severity filter)
Existing Generated Reports Data Table (Filename, Format, Created At, File Size, Actions: Download / Open / Delete)
Interactive In-App HTML Report Preview Modal

scan_history.title: Historical Scan Audit Log
scan_history.description: Track posture trends over time and compare scan differentials
features: Historical Scans Data Table (Timestamp, Target Path, Profile Used, Duration, Findings Breakdown, Status)
Scan Comparison Drawer: Select 2 historical scans to view Diff (New vulnerabilities introduced, Fixed vulnerabilities)

settings.title: Engine Configuration & Preferences
settings.description: Tune detection engine, intelligence feeds, and desktop UI behavior

tabs.name: General & Engine
tabs.editor: Interactive Scanner Engine Config JSON Editor for 7 core keys (max_file_size_mb, threads, ignore_patterns, severe_threshold, fail_on_critical, enable_entropy_secrets, telemetry_opt_out)

tabs.name: Vulnerability Intelligence
tabs.controls: OSV Cache TTL, Offline Mode Toggle, Custom Rule Path

tabs.name: Appearance & Accessibility
tabs.controls: Density Picker (Compact / Comfortable), Text Scale (100% / 110% / 120%), Reduced Motion Toggle

tabs.name: Reports Default
tabs.controls: Default Export Path, Default Format, Company Branding Name

tabs.name: About PipelineGuard
tabs.controls: Version info, FastAPI Engine Status, Tauri Bridge Ready status, License, Core Rule set version

motion_and_microinteractions.transitions: Use explicit properties e.g. transition-colors duration-150, transition-transform duration-200. NEVER use transition: all.
motion_and_microinteractions.hover_effects: Subtle border lighting (#364144 to #4A575A), gentle opacity or shadow shift.
motion_and_microinteractions.progress_animations: Smooth width transitions for scan progress stepper and progress bars.
motion_and_microinteractions.accessibility: Respect prefers-reduced-motion, provide data-testid on every interactive control.

key_elements: Top header project/profile dropdowns and start scan button
Scan project folder path input and profile cards
Findings table rows, search input, and inspector drawer elements
OSV query form fields and result containers
Reports export trigger and report rows
Settings JSON editor inputs and tab triggers

hall_of_shame_forbidden_patterns: NO neon glowing borders or intense cyberpunk grid lines
NO bright green backgrounds or full green canvas fills
NO fake terminal green matrix animations
NO oversized marketing headlines or centered marketing copy
NO extra cat images or mascots anywhere in the app (only cyber-cat logo in header)
NO transparent dropdown menus or missing header backdrop blur
NO generic empty tables without polished empty states
instructions_to_main_agent: Build a complete, desktop-grade DevSecOps Security Application UI in React with Tailwind CSS and Lucide React icons.
Ensure all 8 pages are fully navigable via the left sidebar: Dashboard, Scan Project, Findings, Dependencies, OSV Intelligence, Reports, Scan History, Settings.
Implement real working state and simulated FastAPI scanning engine bridge hooks so that clicking 'Start Scan' runs a realistic multi-stage scan progress with live updates.
Use Recharts for charts (Severity Breakdown, Category Distribution, Scan Score Trend).

Use exact color tokens: #111619 (main bg), #101416 (sidebar/header/status bar), #1B2225 (cards), #252C2B (secondary), #364144 (borders), #F1F4F3 (primary text), #A4B0B0 (secondary text), #A4D65E (security accent), #FF5964 (critical), #F0B65C (warning).
Attach data-testid to every interactive component, button, input, and table cell.
Ensure smooth dark titanium aesthetic with high data density, tabular numbers for stats, clear status badges, and right-side inspector panels.
